name: How long does a wheelchair accessible kitchen remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a wheelchair accessible kitchen remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a wheelchair-accessible kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and the extent of modifications. A full renovation, including structural changes and custom cabinetry, can take 6-12 weeks from demolition to completion. Smaller projects, such as installing a new sink and modifying a counter, might be completed in 2-4 weeks. Factors like permit approval times and material availability can also influence the schedule. Your contractor will provide a more accurate timeline during the planning phase.
